title: Teaming Strategies in Football: Patterns and Effects
source_quality: 25-page PDF, text layer fully readable. MATHmodels watermark on every page. Some private-use Unicode glyphs in mathematical notation but all formulas recoverable from context. R and Matlab code in appendix.

official_requirements: Build a model to identify network properties of a soccer team
task_reconstruction.official_context_status: Problem D 2020: Soccer team cooperation analysis
task_reconstruction.paper_approach: Directed weighted passing network → AHP+entropy individual contribution scoring → logistic regression → heterogeneity analysis → coaching recommendations for Huskies → extension to general team cooperation.
task_reconstruction.paper_coverage: All four requirements addressed. Network properties fully analyzed. Match outcome prediction claims 96.1% accuracy. Recommendations are concrete and data-driven.
coverage_gaps: Temporal network dynamics explored but not integrated into regression

9 major sections listed.

5 assumptions: position difference, substitution stability, 4 behavior types, formation classification, tactical style stability.
Symbol table for network and model variables.
Directed weighted passing network construction from event data.
46 double-pass, 280 single-pass dyads; 16 triad configurations.
Formation classification (offensive/defensive/balanced) with stadium schematic.
Bar chart of shots, possession, passes, pass rate.
Clustering coefficient, closeness centrality, dispersion, shortest path defined and computed.
Time series of network center ratio and closeness std.
Defer individual match analysis to appendix.
Classification tree of regression indicators: individual, structure, strategy, environment.
Event classification, AHP hierarchy, entropy weight method.
Equal-weight average of AHP and entropy weights; player scoring formula.
Football metrics + network indicators as regression IVs.
Formation and offensive style classification.
13-IV logistic regression with environment controls.
VIF test shows severe multicollinearity; stepwise correction.
R² close to 1, significant p-value, robustness check.
Subgroup regression by opponent formation type.
Significant variables: score std (+), pass completion (+), possession (-), closeness std (-), home (+).
Huskies-specific regression and coaching recommendations.

contributions.summary: Applies SNA to football passing data; constructs directed weighted network with dyad/triad analysis.
Combines AHP and entropy weight for position-specific player scoring.
Comprehensive 4-dimension IV set for match outcome prediction.
Formation effectiveness shown to be opponent-conditional.
Data-driven coaching recommendations for Huskies team.
Systematic mapping from football to general team cooperation.

weak_links: Time dimension explored but never enters regression

assumptions.summary: Position difference principle: players in different positions have different evaluation criteria.
Substitution stability: substitutions do not significantly alter team structure.
Four behavior types: player actions classified into 4 categories.
Formation classification into offensive, defensive, and balanced.

data_and_preprocessing.summary: Match event logs for Huskies team, 76 matches in one season.
Passing events filtered and aggregated into directed weighted adjacency matrix.
Player actions classified into 4 types by position (Table2).

models.summary: Directed weighted graph: nodes=players, edges=pass counts. Dyad/triad configurations extracted.
Analytic Hierarchy Process for subjective scoring weights with CR<0.1 consistency.
Information entropy for objective scoring weights from data dispersion.
Equal-weight average of AHP and entropy weights; position-specific player scores.
13-IV logistic regression for match outcome prediction. Stepwise correction for multicollinearity.
Subgroup regression by opponent formation type to test interaction effects.

verification.summary: CR < 0.1 consistency check passed for AHP judgment matrix.
Variance Inflation Factor multicollinearity diagnostic applied; severe collinearity found and corrected.
Expanded offensive style from 3 to 5 categories; results remain significant.
96.1% in-sample prediction accuracy (73/76 correct). No cross-validation.

results_trace.summary: model output: coefficient table → visual: Table6 → interpretation: R² close to 1, most variables significant → answer: comprehensive IV set predicts match outcomes.

model output: subgroup coefficients → visual: Table7 matrix → interpretation: formation effectiveness is opponent-conditional → answer: defensive formation only significant against balanced opponents.
model output: Huskies regression → visual: Table8 → interpretation: defensive formation + right-wing attack significant → answer: concrete coaching recommendations.

writing_logic.summary: Four-verb gerund chain as framework opener; method enumeration; result claim; extension statement.
Background with literature anchors → gap identification → restatement → our work overview.
Classification tree overview → sub-model development → variable construction → regression setup.
Bullet-point interpretation of each significant variable; counterintuitive finding on possession rate.
Systematic 'can be extended to' mapping, repeated 7+ times, from football to general teams.
Team cooperation as important factor; big data era framing; method recap; limitation acknowledgment.

language_observations.summary: Four-verb gerund chain: identifying-expanding-exploring-putting forward. Progressive escalation framework.
'embodied in the performance of' — distinctly non-native but common MCM collocation.
'It can be seen from the table that' — most common MCM evidence-citing phrase.
'Due to the limitation of space, we do not show' — classic MCM space-limitation apology.
'can be extended to' repeated 7+ times — mechanical repetition as deliberate rhetorical strategy.
'It is worth mentioning that' — self-highlighting move rarely generated by AI.

weaknesses.summary: R² close to 1 for logistic regression with small sample — strong overfitting signal.
Equal-weight AHP-entropy fusion lacks theoretical justification.
Subgroups (~25 obs each) severely underpowered for 10+ variable regression.
Small sample (76 matches for 13 IVs, below 10:1 rule).
Stepwise regression unstable in small samples; no bootstrap validation.
Temporal features explored but never enter regression model.
R code uses hardcoded local path; not reproducible.

independent_extensions.summary: Add cross-validation (k-fold or LOOCV) to the logistic regression to validate the 96.1% accuracy claim.
Integrate temporal network metrics into the regression model to exploit the time-dimension analysis.
Test sensitivity of results to the AHP-entropy fusion weight (vary from 0 to 1).
Model opponent interactions in the passing network (two-team network rather than single-team).
Apply the framework to multiple teams/seasons to test generalizability beyond Huskies.

candidate_rule_impacts.rationale: Second D paper constructing directed weighted passing network; confirms network-as-data-object pattern.
Uses comprehensive multi-dimension indicator system spanning individual, structural, strategic, and environmental factors.
AHP used for subjective weighting with CR consistency check.
VIF diagnostic + stepwise correction + robustness check demonstrates multi-level validation.
Rich human language patterns: 'It can be seen from', 'embodied in', space-limitation apology, gerund chains.
Formation + offensive style as strategic layout variables; practical coaching recommendations.

unresolved_questions: Which pseudo-R² variant (McFadden, Cox-Snell, Nagelkerke) was used?
What are the exact subgroup sample sizes for heterogeneity analysis?
Was the 96.1% accuracy computed on training data or held-out data?
What is the exact CR value for the AHP consistency check?
How were substitutions handled in the passing network?
What stepwise selection criteria (AIC, BIC, p-value) were used?

judge_relevance_hypotheses.summary: The network science approach may have appealed as methodologically novel for Problem D, but the paper alone cannot establish why judges awarded it.
Practical actionable recommendations and the generalisation to non-sport teams may have demonstrated applied value, but this is speculative.
